_meta.name: Personal Injury Legal Ops & Settlement Suite
_meta.description: End-to-end personal injury automation: multilingual AI intake (English, Spanish, Haitian Creole), medical billing and treatment chronology extractor, damage calculator, and automated settlement brochure preparation with attorney sign-off.

nodes.name: Multilingual Intake
nodes.subtitle: EN / ES / HT Voice & Form Intake
nodes.description: Captures accident report, liability details, and initial caller narrative with automatic language detection (English, Spanish, Haitian Creole).

nodes.name: Medical Records Parser
nodes.subtitle: Treatment Chronology & Diagnostics
nodes.description: Parses medical documents, builds chronological treatment timeline, categorizes providers, and flags documentation gaps.

nodes.name: Special Damages Ledger
nodes.subtitle: Medical Expenses & Billing Audit
nodes.description: Extracts medical bills, itemizes expenses per hospital/provider, calculates special damages totals, and links supporting billing invoices.

nodes.name: Settlement Brochure Package
nodes.subtitle: AI Demand Letter & Exhibit Index
nodes.description: Drafts structured settlement brochure, demand letter to insurer, and organized exhibit index without hallucinating unverified injuries.

nodes.name: Attorney Approval Gate
nodes.subtitle: Human Sign-off & Insurer Dispatch
nodes.description: Stages complete demand package in Action Center for attorney review and one-click authorization before dispatch to insurance adjusters.
